definitions.explanation: The proportion of a population that becomes infected with a disease, usually given as a percentage. Also used of computer viruses spreading through a network.

examples.japanese: {感染率|かんせんりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がって→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧きた。
examples.english: The infection rate has been coming down.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{感染率|かんせんりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The infection rate in this area is higher than the national average.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手洗|てあら}い→手洗い：12761_tearai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧たことで、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感染率|かんせんりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{低|ひく}く→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: By keeping up handwashing and ventilation, we were able to hold the infection rate at the school down.

notes:
⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧ (infection) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate). Became everyday news vocabulary during the COVID-19 pandemic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感染率|かんせんりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have a high infection rate
- {感染率|かんせんりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: to bring the infection rate down
- {感染率|かんせんりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{推移|すいい}→推移：05579_suii⟧: the trend in the infection rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}→感染者数：30152_kansenshasuu⟧: number of infected people — a raw count rather than a proportion
- ⟦{致死率|ちしりつ}→致死率：30149_chishiritsu⟧: fatality rate — the proportion of infected people who die
